old_title: Mastercard reportedly down due to 'global' issue
new_title: Shoppers' payments declined due to 'global' Mastercard outage
old_text:
Mastercard reportedly down due to 'global' issue
In short:
Shoppers around Australia are reporting issues with declined card payments on Saturday afternoon.
The payment issues have been caused by a "global Mastercard issue", Commbank says in a statement.
What's next?
The ABC has contacted Mastercard for comment.
new_text:
Mastercard payments declined due to 'global' outage caused by system update
In short:
Shoppers around Australia reported issues with declined card payments on Saturday afternoon.
Mastercard said the issues were caused by a "scheduled system update".
All systems are now "working as normal", Mastercard said.
